answer: Work is accepted only from keys that hold a numbered slot in a public atlas of weekly landing times. A slot is activated by answering a live challenge at the jetty in a 90-minute tide window, and the same session fingerprint cannot open two slots. Each slot also locks 1,800 units until the window closes. One hundred aliases therefore require one hundred distinct 90-minute attendances and 180,000 units locked, while an honest agent attends once and locks 1,800.
